“Sparkling water” most commonly means carbonated water—water with dissolved carbon dioxide that creates bubbles. It can be:
- Naturally carbonated mineral water (from a spring), or
- Artificially carbonated (often called seltzer). Club soda is similar but usually has added minerals/salts.

Other uses of the term:
- Sparkling Water (software): an H2O.ai integration for Apache Spark that lets you build and deploy machine-learning models at Spark scale.
